The Training page (training, under the Control sidebar group) lets you inspect praisonai-train agent training sessions, compare iteration scores, and apply the best training profile to any registered agent.

Training sessions are read from JSON files in the first directory that applies: $PRAISON_TRAIN_DIR environment variable /train (when $AIUI_DATA_DIR or --datastore sets a data directory) ~/.praison/train (default praisonai-train directory) praisonai-train is an optional dependency: Without praisonai-train: Listing sessions and viewing full iteration reports still work directly from the JSON files; POST /api/training/sessions/{session_id}/apply returns HTTP 503 with an install hint (pip install praisonai-train). With praisonai-train installed: Clicking Apply (or calling /apply) runs praisonai_train.train.agents.apply_training() on the selected agent definition.

Method Path Description GET /api/training/status Package availability, version, storage directory, session count, and warnings GET /api/training/sessions List session summaries sorted by newest first (?limit=50&agent_id=...) GET /api/training/sessions/{session_id} Full report, per-iteration scores, best_iteration, early-stop info, and scenarios POST /api/training/sessions/{session_id}/apply Apply the best (or specified iteration) training profile to agent_id
Omit iteration to automatically select the highest-scoring iteration.
